source: Esri World Imagery zoom 18 (~0.54 m/px); roof detection by scripts/satellite/run.py
method: Rows of light roofs detected and fitted with rectangles; blocks deeper than 19 m are back-to-back rows facing outward; homes per row = row length / 7.8 m; large blocks next to apartment projects are apartment buildings; project = nearest Emaar project pin. Positions, row outlines and street sides are from the imagery; the split into homes, building heights and the design are representative until each project cluster map is traced.
